messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service/payment-gateway, release=release-2026-04-02, targets=10% traffic -> 1789456123 :rocket:
maya: noticing elevated 5xx from canary pods, sigterm/exiting logs, hitting retries. looks like payment flow failing for a subset of users :rotating_light:
maya: curl to canary endpoint 10.0.12.34: got 502 with upstream read timeout, truncated headers in logs
maya: paging oncall-bot for SRE oncall, possible bad artifact or config
oncall-bot: Paging SRE oncall: @sre_carlos — high error rate on payment-gateway canary. Channel: eng-oncall. Incident severity: P1 (potential customer impact).
sre_carlos: on it, joining. pls add any quick repros/links.
maya: logs attached (snippet):
```
[2026-04-02T18:02:11Z] ERR upstream read timeout id=abcd1234 request_id=rx-9b2
[2026-04-02T18:02:12Z] WARN dep: connection reset while forwarding to 10.0.12.34:8080
```
sre_carlos: questions: 1) is this new image/tag or config? 2) any recent infra changes?
eng_lead_anna: deploy was a promoted artifact from CI — tag release-2026-04-02, promoted today at 17:55. No infra changes recorded. I'm going to check artifact registry.
ops_jen: I'm looking at ingress LB logs — errors correlate with canary nodes only, production stable nodes look fine. Suggest we kill traffic to canary while we investigate.
leo: quick check: docker registry seems to have two manifests for release-2026-04-02: one points to digest sha256:old111 and later one points to sha256:new222 but the manifest index for the region edge cache still resolving to old111. might be a propagation/stale-index issue with our artifact CDN proxy.
ci-bot: Build 2026-04-02T17:45 pipeline succeeded, image digest=sha256:new222, metadata: {build_id:ci-31415, promote_ts:1789455320}
sre_carlos: ops_jen — please toggle deployment traffic to 0% for the canary subset. Use the feature-flag kill switch if available, otherwise scale down.
ops_jen: running rollback command to remove canary weight:
```
kubectl patch svc payment-gateway --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic/canary/percent","value":0}]'
```
ops_jen: executed. Confirming canary traffic drained. Metrics showing errors drop to baseline. :white_check_mark:
eng_lead_anna: thanks. still need root cause; leo can you validate artifact digests across registries and CDN cache?
leo: doing full manifest fetch from registry and CDN edge:
```
# registry
curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json" https://registry.internal/repositories/payment-gateway/manifests/release-2026-04-02 | jq -r .config.digest
# -> sha256:new222

# cdn edge
curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json" https://cdn.internal/repo/payment-gateway/manifests/release-2026-04-02 | jq -r .config.digest
# -> sha256:old111
```
leo: looks like CDN cache was not invalidated on promote; old manifest index still served to some k8s nodes which pulled the old image with incompatible layers. That caused runtime mismatch and crashes.
ci-bot: noted — promote step should call cdn invalidation. open PR to add explicit cdn-purge job.
eng_lead_anna: immediate mitigation done (canary traffic 0). Next: decide whether to redeploy with pinned digest or re-promote after CDN purge. Thoughts?
sre_carlos: short-term: redeploy canary pinned to sha256:new222 (explicit digest) to avoid manifest resolution race; medium-term: update CI to purge CDN after promote and add validation check that digest resolves consistently across registries.
ops_jen: redeploying canary with digest pinned:
```
kubectl set image deployment/payment-gateway payment-gateway=registry.internal/payment-gateway@sha256:new222 --record
```
ops_jen: new canary pods coming up, healthchecks passing so far. Monitoring for 10m before resuming traffic.
maya: customer-impact note: partial 502s for ~4% of traffic between 17:55-18:03 UTC, most retries successful but some checkout failures observed. raising support ticket to customers impacted.
sre_carlos: created incident ticket INF-2026-042 and assigned postmortem owner @eng_lead_anna. action items: 1) CDN purge step in CI; 2) add registry-digest-consistency check to promote job; 3) add canary rollback automation when manifest mismatch detected; 4) improve runbook for artifact propagation issues.
eng_lead_anna: adding FF kill-switch doc to runbook.
leo: I'll start PR for CDN purge + add a diff-check script that queries registry + CDN and fails if mismatch.
ci-bot: created task CI-789 to add purge and CI-790 to add validation.
sre_carlos: nice work. leaving oncall to ops_jen for monitoring, I'll follow up on postmortem.
ops_jen: monitoring green at 18:18 UTC, no further errors after pin redeploy. Will keep watch for 1h.
oncall-bot: Incident INF-2026-042 severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 after mitigation at 1789456934.
maya: thanks everyone. please add customer comms draft to INF ticket.
eng_lead_anna: will do. follow-up: schedule a quick retro tomorrow with CI and platform teams.
ci-bot: note: temporarily reverting promotion automation to manual until CDN invalidation is implemented.
sre_carlos: closing this slack thread for visibility, we'll continue async in the incident ticket. Good job. :clap:
